description: Parallel-array definition of battle log objectives (mission tasks), evaluated every tick into success/failure progress and shown in the HUD.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_MissionTask. Task ids are normally obtained from a MissionTaskLottery weighted pick (or PvESettings.MissionTaskIds) and resolved against MissionTaskDataTables (DTM+0x9E0). The member is not otherwise read as data by consumers.

ValueType.simple: Battle-log value to measure for each indexed condition.
ValueType.technical: TArray<EGameBattleLogValueType>, default empty. Its Num() is the authoritative task count for the runtime loop; None entries are skipped by the story-state all-conditions evaluator, and FirstAttack entries are force-failed by FailFirstAttackTasks when a non-player team attacks. Each non-None value is passed to AGameBattleManager::EvaluateLog together with the same-index TargetType and PassiveType.

TargetType.simple: Whose battle log value is evaluated.
TargetType.technical: TArray<EGameBattleLogTargetType>, default empty. Ally collects the player's team characters, Myself only the player, Enemy the rival team; EvaluateLog returns false when no characters resolve. Values are consumed at the same index as ValueType and PassiveType.

PassiveType.simple: Whether the logged value is sent or received.
PassiveType.technical: TArray<EGameBattleLogPassiveType>, default empty. Passed with the same-index ValueType/TargetType to EvaluateLog, which sums the selected log entries with that passive classification. The exported rows commonly pair Receive with ForceGauge conditions and Send with hit-count conditions.

Value.simple: Threshold for each indexed task condition.
Value.technical: TArray<float>, default empty. Copied into FStudioMissionTaskProgress.Target. Success conditions compare the evaluated log value with >= or <= the target; failure conditions compute a decreasing/increasing Current from the target and fail at zero/crossing. On success Current is clamped to Target. The first entries are also formatted into HUD text as the VALUE parameter and story objective text.

ConditionType.simple: Comparison rule that decides success or failure.
ConditionType.technical: TArray<EGameBattleLogConditionType>, default empty. Success_GreaterThanEquals/Success_LessThanEquals set State=1 immediately when the log value crosses Value[i]; Failure_GreaterThanEquals/Failure_LessThanEquals set State=-1 when a written condition is reached, otherwise remain pending. Pending failure conditions are treated as successful on event 13 when the battle result is Win_TeamA.

Id_BattleText_TaskDetail.technical: TArray<FName>, default empty. The battle mission-task list widget iterates this array in parallel with Value and TaskProgress; None hides the widget. Story objective helpers use Index-1 (index 0 is reserved for a generic objective), validate IsValidIndex and non-None, and write the text id plus Value[Index-1] as a VALUE parameter.

ExcludeBindingVowsEffectType.simple: Binding-vow effect types disallowed by this task.
ExcludeBindingVowsEffectType.technical: TArray<EGameBindingVowsEffectType>, default empty fixed-width arrays in the export. In PvE interval setup, each candidate vow's effect rows are collected and a candidate is removed if any EffectType is contained in this array; the same filtering is also done from MissionOrder.ExcludeBindingVowsEffectType.

notes: The exported asset contains 151 rows with FGameDataTableRow_MissionTask; the manager loads MissionTaskDataTable into MissionTaskDataTables (DTM+0x9E0).

All condition arrays are parallel and ValueType.Num() drives the runtime loop. The reconstructed code does not check that TargetType, PassiveType, Value, ConditionType or Id_BattleText_TaskDetail have the same length, so rows must be authored consistently.

Task state is cached in FStudioBattleMissionTaskSystem::TaskProgress keyed by the array index; aliases from the data row through AGameBattleManager::GetMissionTask, HUD widget and story objective helpers are documented in usages.

Consumers are reconstructed from retail functions such as 0x1055FE0; consult status/functions.json before treating any of them as byte-matched. Partial Content and uninspected Blueprint uses limit completeness.

usages.detail: FStudioBattleMissionTaskSystem::Tick evaluates every indexed condition and writes progress state.
FailFirstAttackTasks force-fails FirstAttack tasks when the attacking team is not the player.
Renders per-condition task text, target and current progress from the row and cached TaskProgress.
Checks all non-None row conditions through EvaluateLog for story-state completion.
Story demo objective presence, completion and text formatting read task detail ids and values.
